added.member: Dialog, Sheet, Popover, Tooltip, ToastStack, Select, Collapsible, Accordion (ui/controls)
added.summary: The built-in overlays and disclosures ported from NSH base, each owning its open state for screen readers, its focus and its keys (`back` closes) and leaving its look to the pack's slots: `Dialog.frame`, `Dialog.title`, `Dialog.body` and `Dialog.actions` over `Modal.scrim`; `Sheet.frame` (sliding up) and `Sheet.grabber`; `Popover.frame` and `Tooltip.frame` following their trigger; `Toast.stack` and `Toast.frame[.success|.danger]`, announced as they arrive; `Select.trigger`, `Select.list` and `Select.option`; `Collapsible.trigger`, `Collapsible.chevron`, `Collapsible.panel` and `Accordion.item`. The game owns every open state and value.

`clamp="edge"` on an element anchored to a UI node (a tooltip, a popover) shifts its drawn box along each axis to stay `clampMargin` px inside the screen, as Floating UI's `shift` does; Popover and Tooltip use it with 8 px, so one on a trigger at the screen's edge is no longer cut.
